facts: The dataset covers 35 fintech data companies.
Combined total raised across 35 fintech data companies is £227.5m.
Januus.io ranks first with £27.9m total raised.
The lowest value in the ranking is £2m (CapRelease).
First place is 14 times the value of last place.
The top 9 hold 51.8% of the combined total (£117.9m).
Where they are based. London: 30 (85.7%), £209.5m combined; East Midlands: 1 (2.9%), £2.5m combined; East of England: 1 (2.9%), £2.8m combined; South West: 1 (2.9%), £5.9m combined.

Most common sectors. Wealth, asset and investment management: 14 (40%), £107m combined; Robots and automation: 13 (37.1%), £77m combined; Budgeting and financial management: 12 (34.3%), £73.8m combined; Risk and compliance: 10 (28.6%), £95.2m combined.

copy.title: Top 35 UK Seed-Stage Fintech Data Companies by Total Raised
copy.h1: Top 35 UK Seed-Stage Fintech Data Companies by Total Raised
copy.metaDescription: See which UK seed-stage fintech data companies have raised the most, led by Januus.io with £27.9m, plus sector, location and team size patterns in this ranking.
intro: This page ranks 35 UK seed-stage fintech data companies by total raised. Januus.io ranks first with £27.9m, and Nous ranks second with £15.4m.
The combined total raised across all 35 companies is £227.5m. The median is £5m and the mean is £6.5m, so a small number of larger rounds lift the average.

sections.heading: Where the top UK seed-stage fintech data companies are based
paragraphs: London is the base for 30 of the 35 companies, with a combined total of £209.5m. The East Midlands, East of England and South West each have one company in the dataset.
The top 9 companies hold 51.8% of the combined total, which is £117.9m. First place is 14 times the value of last place, which is CapRelease at £2m.

sections.heading: Sectors and team sizes in UK fintech data
paragraphs: Wealth, asset and investment management is the largest group by sector, with 14 companies and a combined total of £107m. Robots and automation has 13 companies, and budgeting and financial management has 12.
By team size, 20 companies have 10 to 24 employees, and this is the largest group with a combined total of £116.8m. Eight companies have 5 to 9 employees.

sections.heading: What the leading companies do
paragraphs: Januus.io develops a cryptowallet-to-identity database which provides ownership data for cryptocurrency assets, wallets and transactions. capsa.ai develops AI software for private equity firms which aims to accelerate the due diligence process through automating reporting and analysis.
Outpost develops an automated Merchant of Record and Tax of Record platform, and DoorFeed provides investment funds with end-to-end management and analysis of large-scale property portfolios.
